Contract Title: Damaged Roads Clearing and Restoration in South Lebanon
- Bint Jbeil Caza.

Loan No.: 9841 - LB                                                                                  

RFB Reference No.: LEAP-SW2-Bint Jbeil

 

2. The Republic of Lebanon (hereinafter called “Borrower”) has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Lebanon Emergency Assistance Project (LEAP) and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for “Damaged Roads Clearing and Restoration in South Lebanon - Bint Jbeil Caza.  For this contract, the Borrower shall process the payments using the Direct Payment disbursement method, as defined in the World Bank’s Disbursement Guidelines for Investment Project Financing.

 

2. The Council for Development and Reconstruction (CDR) now invites sealed Bids from eligible Bidders for the Damaged Roads Clearing and Restoration in South Lebanon - Bint Jbeil Caza, consisting of providing restoration works.

 

3. Bidding will be conducted through National competitive procurement using a Request for Bids (RFB) as specified in the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers - Sixth Edition, February 2025”, and is open to all Bidders as defined in the Procurement Regulations. The contract will be awarded to the Bidder offering the lowest evaluated cost to the Employer, subject that the selected Bidder meets the required qualification criteria, and the requirements as specified under paragraph 4 below.

 

4. Bidders submitting their bids, must ensure that the following criteria are met and included in their bid: 

Financial capabilities requirements stipulated in Section III - Evaluation and Qualification Criteria - Eligibility and Qualification Criteria Paragraph 3.1

  • Average Annual Construction Turnover requirements stipulated in Section III - Evaluation and Qualification Criteria - Eligibility and Qualification Criteria Paragraph 3.2
  • Key Personnel stipulated in Section III - Evaluation and Qualification Criteria Paragraph 4.
  • Equipment stipulated in Section III - Evaluation and Qualification Criteria Paragraph 5.

 

 

5. Interested eligible Bidders may obtain further information from the Council for Development and Reconstruction and inspect the bidding documents at the address given below from 9:00 to 15:00 hours (Beirut local time) from Monday till Friday.

 

6. Interested eligible Bidders may purchase the bidding documents. The bidding document in English may be purchased by interested eligible Bidders upon the submission of a written application to the address below and upon payment of a nonrefundable fee of One Hundred fresh US Dollars (US$ 100). The method of payment will be in cash (fresh USD). The document is to be picked up by a person duly authorized by the applicant. The cash is collected by the Tenders Department at CDR, and a receipt is issued to the person purchasing the bidding document at the time of payment.

 

7. Bids must be delivered to the address below at or before 12:00 noon Beirut Local Time on Thursday, October 29, 2026.  Electronic Bidding will not be permitted.  Late Bids will be rejected. Bids will be publicly opened in the presence of the Bidders’ designated representatives and anyone who chooses to attend at the address below at 12:00 noon Beirut Local Time on Thursday, October 29, 2026.

 

8. All Bids must be accompanied by a Bid Security of One Hundred Sixty Thousand fresh US Dollars (US$ 160,000).

 

9. All Bids must be accompanied by a Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (SEA) and/or Sexual Harassment (SH) Declaration.

 

10. Attention is drawn to the Procurement Regulations requiring the Borrower to disclose information on the successful bidder’s beneficial ownership, as part of the Contract Award Notice, using the Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Form as included in the bidding document.

 

11. A Pre-Bid Meeting (Physical Presence) will be held on Friday, October 23, 2026 at 10:00 A.M. Beirut Local Time.                                                                                                    .

Anaklia Regional Gateway and Overland Connectivity Project

GENERAL PROCUREMENT NOTICE (GPN)

Project ID No. P519916

The Government of Georgia intends to apply for financing from the World Bank towards the cost of Anaklia Regional Gateway and Overland Connectivity Project, and it intends to apply part of the proceeds to payments for goods, works, non-consulting services and consulting services to be procured under this Project.  

The project will include the following main components:

Component 1: Civil Works (US$ 205 million). This component will finance the design and build of a railway and related infrastructure connecting to the Anaklia Deep-Sea Port. The contract will be implemented in accordance with the “Conditions of Contract for Plant & Design-Build for Electrical & Mechanical Plant & for Building & Engineering Works Designed by the Contractor (“Yellow book”) Second edition 2017, reprinted 2022 with amendments”. The scope of works includes, inter alia, design and construction of embankment, construction/reconstruction of railway stations and related facilities, railway track, superstructure and overhead contact line in the stations, construction of railway track and overhead catenary system on the main line.

Component 2: Consulting Services (US$ 8.5 million). This component will finance the consulting services for supervision of design and build of a railway and related infrastructure connecting to the Anaklia Deep-Sea Port. The primary objectives of the Services are as follows: (i) review the Contractor’s detailed design and verify its compliance with the Employer’s Requirements; (ii) function as the Engineer in administering the works contract and execution of all rights and responsibilities of the Engineer in accordance with the “Conditions of Contract for Plant & Design-Build for Electrical & Mechanical Plant & for Building & Engineering Works Designed by the Contractor (“Yellow book”) Second edition 2017, reprinted 2022 with amendments”; (iii) comprehensive supervision of design activities and works carried out by the Contractor to ensure compliance with the drawings, technical specifications and various stipulations contained in the contract documents, with high standards of quality assurance in supervision and in the execution of works; (iv) advise the Client on all matters concerning the contract management and support the Client to have the works completed within the stipulated time for completion and budget.

Procurement of contracts under the Project will be conducted through the procedures as specified in the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers for Goods, Works, Non-Consulting and Consulting Services, dated September 2025, Seventh Edition, and is open to all eligible firms and individuals as defined in the Procurement Regulations[1]. The World Bank shall arrange the publication on its external website of the agreed initial procurement plan and all subsequent updates once it has provided no objection.

Specific Procurement Notices (SPN) for contracts subject to open international competitive procurement will be announced, as they become available, on the World Bank’s external website and official webpage of the JSC Georgian Railway (GR).[2]

SPN for “Design and Build of a Railway and Related Infrastructure Connecting to the Anaklia Deep-Sea Port” is expected to be published at the end of October / in the beginning of November 2026.

notice_text: INSTITUTO NACIONAL DE ESTATÍSTICA PROJECTO DE ESTATÍSTICAS REGIONAIS DA SADC CONVITE PARA A MANIFESTAÇÃO DE INTERESSE CONSULTOR INDIVIDUAL REGIME ESPECIAL PAÍS: MOÇAMBIQUE Fonte de Financiamento: Grant E2700 Projecto: P175731 Refª: MZ-INE-570603-CS-INDV CONTRATAÇÃO DE CONSULTOR EM DESENVOLVIMENTO, POPULAÇÃO E POLÍTICAS SOCIAIS O Instituto Nacional de Estatística (INE) recebeu uma subvenção da Associação Internacional de Desenvolvimento (AID), instituição do Banco Mundial, para a implementação do Projecto Regional de Estatísticas da SADC (PRESADC), e pretende aplicar parte dos fundos para a contratação de um Consultor Individual – Especialista em Desenvolvimento, População e Políticas Sociais , para apoiar a Direcção Nacional de Políticas Económicas e Desenvolvimento (DNPED) do Ministério da Planificação e Desenvolvimento (MPD). Os serviços de consultoria (“Serviços”) visam apoiar a DNPED na concepção, realização e divulgação de estudos que produzam evidências para a formulação e o aperfeiçoamento da política económica e de desenvolvimento, tendo em conta a dinâmica demográfica, a aceleração da transição demográfica e as condições para o aproveitamento do dividendo demográfico, com recurso prioritário aos dados do Sistema Estatístico Nacional, em co-produção com os técnicos da DNPED e assegurando a transferência de conhecimentos. Mais detalhes sobre os serviços e as responsabilidades da consultoria encontram-se nos Termos de Referência (TdR). Os requisitos mínimos de qualificação são: Mestrado em Economia, Demografia, Estatística, Economia do Desenvolvimento, Políticas Públicas, Estudos de Desenvolvimento ou área relacionada; mínimo de 8 (oito) anos de experiência profissional relevante em economia do desenvolvimento, demografia, políticas sociais, investigação aplicada ou áreas relacionadas; e domínio da língua portuguesa. Serão ainda avaliados: estudos aplicados em dinâmica, transição e dividendo demográfico; estudos sobre pobreza, desigualdade ou capital humano com microdados de inquéritos; análise quantitativa (Stata, R, Python ou equivalente); notas de política e comunicação a órgãos de decisão; capacitação e transferência de conhecimentos; e experiência em Moçambique, no sector público ou em organizações internacionais. O Contrato terá duração de 12 (doze) meses, a partir da data de celebração do contrato, com base na DNPED, em Maputo. Os candidatos interessados e com o perfil requerido deverão submeter os seguintes documentos: Carta de Manifestação de Interesse, assinada; Curriculum Vitae actualizado e assinado, em língua portuguesa; cópias dos diplomas ou certificados de habilitações académicas (graus estrangeiros com a respectiva equivalência); comprovativos da experiência declarada (estudos, relatórios, notas de política, declarações das entidades contratantes ou referências verificáveis); e contactos de três (3) referências profissionais. As candidaturas deverão ser entregues até às 15:00 horas do dia 05 de Novembro de 2026 no endereço Instituto Nacional de Estatística – Avenida 24 de Julho nº1989, Piso 09- Sala 0901, Cidade de Maputo. Email: presadc.concursos@gmail.com O consultor será seleccionado de acordo com os procedimentos do Banco Mundial definidos no Regulamento de Aquisições para Mutuários de Operações de Financiamento de Projectos de Investimento, 6.ª edição, Fevereiro de 2025, particularmente os parágrafos 7.36 – 7.37 sobre Selecção de Consultores Individuais. Os interessados devem prestar particular atenção na Secção III, parágrafos 3.15 a 3.17 do mesmo Regulamento, política sobre conflito de interesse. Funcionários públicos e agentes do Estado só poderão ser contratados nas condições e casos excepcionais previstos no referido Regulamento. Os Termos de Referência e outros detalhes sobre a consultoria poderão ser obtidos no endereço acima e também estão disponíveis em www.ine.gov.mz/concursos. Somente o candidato melhor classificado será convidado para a negociação dos honorários e das condições do contrato. 19 de Outubro de 2026 A Autoridade Competente Ilegível

REGIME ESPECIAL

PAÍS: MOÇAMBIQUE

Fonte de Financiamento: Grant E2700

Projecto: P175731

Refª: MZ-INE-570603-CS-INDV

CONTRATAÇÃO DE CONSULTOR EM DESENVOLVIMENTO, POPULAÇÃO E POLÍTICAS SOCIAIS

  1. O Instituto Nacional de Estatística (INE) recebeu uma subvenção da Associação Internacional de Desenvolvimento (AID), instituição do Banco Mundial, para a implementação do Projecto Regional de Estatísticas da SADC (PRESADC), e pretende aplicar parte dos fundos para a contratação de um Consultor Individual – Especialista em Desenvolvimento, População e Políticas Sociais, para apoiar a Direcção Nacional de Políticas Económicas e Desenvolvimento (DNPED) do Ministério da Planificação e Desenvolvimento (MPD).
  2. Os serviços de consultoria (“Serviços”) visam apoiar a DNPED na concepção, realização e divulgação de estudos que produzam evidências para a formulação e o aperfeiçoamento da política económica e de desenvolvimento, tendo em conta a dinâmica demográfica, a aceleração da transição demográfica e as condições para o aproveitamento do dividendo demográfico, com recurso prioritário aos dados do Sistema Estatístico Nacional, em co-produção com os técnicos da DNPED e assegurando a transferência de conhecimentos. Mais detalhes sobre os serviços e as responsabilidades da consultoria encontram-se nos Termos de Referência (TdR).
  3. Os requisitos mínimos de qualificação são: Mestrado em Economia, Demografia, Estatística, Economia do Desenvolvimento, Políticas Públicas, Estudos de Desenvolvimento ou área relacionada; mínimo de 8 (oito) anos de experiência profissional relevante em economia do desenvolvimento, demografia, políticas sociais, investigação aplicada ou áreas relacionadas; e domínio da língua portuguesa. Serão ainda avaliados: estudos aplicados em dinâmica, transição e dividendo demográfico; estudos sobre pobreza, desigualdade ou capital humano com microdados de inquéritos; análise quantitativa (Stata, R, Python ou equivalente); notas de política e comunicação a órgãos de decisão; capacitação e transferência de conhecimentos; e experiência em Moçambique, no sector público ou em organizações internacionais.
  4. O Contrato terá duração de 12 (doze) meses, a partir da data de celebração do contrato, com base na DNPED, em Maputo.
  5. Os candidatos interessados e com o perfil requerido deverão submeter os seguintes documentos: Carta de Manifestação de Interesse, assinada; Curriculum Vitae actualizado e assinado, em língua portuguesa; cópias dos diplomas ou certificados de habilitações académicas (graus estrangeiros com a respectiva equivalência); comprovativos da experiência declarada (estudos, relatórios, notas de política, declarações das entidades contratantes ou referências verificáveis); e contactos de três (3) referências profissionais.
  6. As candidaturas deverão ser entregues até às 15:00 horas do dia 05 de Novembro de 2026 no endereço Instituto Nacional de Estatística – Avenida 24 de Julho nº1989, Piso 09- Sala 0901, Cidade de Maputo. Email: presadc.concursos@gmail.com
  7. O consultor será seleccionado de acordo com os procedimentos do Banco Mundial definidos no Regulamento de Aquisições para Mutuários de Operações de Financiamento de Projectos de Investimento, 6.ª edição, Fevereiro de 2025, particularmente os parágrafos 7.36 – 7.37 sobre Selecção de Consultores Individuais. Os interessados devem prestar particular atenção na Secção III, parágrafos 3.15 a 3.17 do mesmo Regulamento, política sobre conflito de interesse. Funcionários públicos e agentes do Estado só poderão ser contratados nas condições e casos excepcionais previstos no referido Regulamento.
  8. Os Termos de Referência e outros detalhes sobre a consultoria poderão ser obtidos no endereço acima e também estão disponíveis em www.ine.gov.mz/concursos. Somente o candidato melhor classificado será convidado para a negociação dos honorários e das condições do contrato.

The Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist will support the Project Implementation Unit (PIU) in establishing and operationalizing the project's results monitoring, evaluation, reporting, and learning systems. Minimum of five (5) years of relevant professional experience. Experience in monitoring and evaluation of donor-funded projects. Strong analytical, reporting, and data management skills. Experience working within national statistical systems will be an advantage. Excellent computer skills, including statistical and reporting software applications. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) can be obtained from the Ethiopian Statistical Service (ESS) upon request. The consultant will be selected using the Selection of Individual Consultants (INDV) method in accordance with the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers . REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

Individual Consultant Selection

Ethiopian Statistical Service (ESS)

Reference No.: ET-ESS-574158-CS-INDV

Hiring of Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist

The Ethiopian Statistical Service (ESS) intends to recruit a Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) Specialist under the Modernizing Ethiopia's Statistical System Project (MESSP) Preparation Grant, financed by the World Bank.

The Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist will support the Project Implementation Unit (PIU) in establishing and operationalizing the project's results monitoring, evaluation, reporting, and learning systems. The position will play a key role in tracking project performance, ensuring data quality, preparing progress reports, documenting lessons learned, and supporting evidence-based project management.

Duty Station: ESS Headquarters, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.

Reporting: The Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist will report to the Project Manager.

Contract Duration: Full-time assignment. The contract shall commence upon recruitment and cover the project preparation phase and subsequent implementation period. The initial contract period shall be one (1) year, renewable annually based on satisfactory performance and project requirements.

Minimum Qualification Requirements

Interested candidates should possess:

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Statistics, Economics, Monitoring and Evaluation, Development Studies, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience in monitoring and evaluation of donor-funded projects.
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and data management skills.
  • Experience working within national statistical systems will be an advantage.
  • Excellent computer skills, including statistical and reporting software applications.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) can be obtained from the Ethiopian Statistical Service (ESS) upon request.

The consultant will be selected using the Selection of Individual Consultants (INDV) method in accordance with the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers.

Submission Requirements

Interested candidates shall submit Physically:

  • An Expression of Interest (EOI);
  • Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV); and
  • Supporting documents demonstrating relevant qualifications and experience.

Deadline for Submission: 03 Nov 2026 G.C at 5:30 PM (Ethiopia Time)

Dans le cadre de ce programme, l’Agence Nationale de Lutte Antiacridienne (ANLA) bénéficie d’un appui visant à renforcer ses capacités de surveillance, de prospection et de lutte contre le criquet pèlerin. La construction de deux points d’appui à Mao et à Djedda doit permettre d’améliorer le déploiement des équipes, le stockage sécurisé des équipements et pesticides, la maintenance du matériel et la coordination des opérations de terrain. L’objectif de la mission est de réaliser, pour chacun des deux sites, une étude de faisabilité technique, architecturale, économique, financière, environnementale et sociale, ainsi qu’un avant-projet sommaire (APS), afin de retenir les options d’aménagement et de construction les plus adaptées aux besoins opérationnels de l’ANLA. Les prestations portent notamment sur le diagnostic des besoins et des sites, les investigations de terrain, le programme architectural et fonctionnel, l’analyse comparative des variantes, l’élaboration des APS, l’évaluation environnementale et sociale préliminaire et l’estimation des coûts d’investissement, d’exploitation et de maintenance. Les livrables comprennent un rapport de démarrage, un rapport de diagnostic et d’investigations, un rapport provisoire de faisabilité et d’APS, puis un rapport final et les fichiers sources. L’APD et le DAO relèvent d’une étape ultérieure. La durée maximale de la mission est de quarante-cinq (45) jours calendaires, à compter de la date indiquée dans l’ordre de service de démarrage. La mission sera administrée par l’Unité de Coordination Technique et Fiduciaire (UCTF) du PRSA-TD, avec l’appui technique de l’ANLA. Les Termes de Référence détaillés (TDR) et l’avis de recrutement pour la mission sont à consulter auprès du Secrétariat de l’UCTF du PRSA-TD. L’UCTF du PRSA-TD invite dès à présent les firmes de consultants admissibles (« Consultants ») à faire part de leur intérêt à fournir les Services. Les Consultants intéressés doivent fournir des informations démontrant qu’ils possèdent les qualifications requises et l’expérience pertinente pour exécuter les Services. Les critères de sélection d’une liste restreinte sont les suivant  : avoir pour activité principale les études d’architecture, de génie civil et d’infrastructures ; justifier d’au moins dix (10) ans d’expérience générale en études de bâtiments et d’infrastructures ; présenter au moins trois (3) missions pertinentes réalisées au cours des dix dernières années, portant sur des études de faisabilité, APS, APD ou dossiers techniques de bâtiments et infrastructures de complexité comparable ; démontrer une expérience pertinente dans la conception d’installations techniques, logistiques, ateliers, entrepôts ou magasins destinés à des produits présentant des risques particuliers ; justifier d’une expérience dans des zones sahéliennes, arides, semi-arides ou présentant des contraintes climatiques et logistiques comparables ; démontrer des capacités techniques, organisationnelles et managériales adaptées, ainsi qu’un dispositif d’assurance qualité. L’expérience dans des opérations financées par des partenaires techniques et financiers ou exécutées selon des standards internationaux comparables constitue un avantage, sans être une condition éliminatoire. Une expérience exclusivement acquise sur des projets de la Banque mondiale n’est pas exigée. Les critères d’évaluation, détaillés dans les TDR, sont : domaine principal d’activité et ancienneté (15 points) ; expérience générale en études de bâtiments et d’infrastructures (15 points) ; expériences spécifiques comparables (40 points) ; installations techniques ou stockage à risques (10 points) ; contextes climatiques et logistiques comparables (10 points) ; capacités techniques, organisationnelles, managériales et assurance qualité (10 points). Le seuil minimal de qualification est fixé à soixante-quinze (75) points sur cent (100). Les firmes atteignant ce seuil seront classées par ordre décroissant de leurs notes. La firme présentant les meilleures qualifications et expériences pertinentes, classée première, sera invitée à soumettre une proposition technique et financière en vue des négociations et, si celles-ci sont concluantes, de la signature du contrat. Les Consultants peuvent s’associer à d’autres firmes pour renforcer leurs qualifications, en précisant si l’association prend la forme d’un groupement ou d’une sous-traitance. Dans le cas d’un groupement, tous ses membres seront solidairement responsables de l’ensemble du contrat s’ils sont sélectionnés. En cas de groupement, la candidature précisera le chef de file, les membres, la nature de l’association et la répartition envisagée des responsabilités. Les manifestations d’intérêt comprendront une lettre signée, une présentation de la firme et de son domaine principal d’activité, les documents attestant son existence légale, son organisation et ses capacités techniques et managériales, ses références générales et spécifiques, les attestations de bonne exécution et les documents d’assurance qualité. Les références préciseront l’intitulé de la mission, le client, le pays, les dates, les prestations réalisées et le rôle de la firme, ainsi que, dans la mesure du possible, les coordonnées du client. En cas de groupement, la lettre d’intention ou l’accord de groupement sera joint. Le personnel clé ne sera pas noté au stade de l’évaluation des manifestations d’intérêt. Les CV détaillés des experts, la méthodologie complète et la proposition financière seront demandés uniquement à la firme classée première, avant les négociations. La sélection sera effectuée selon la méthode de Sélection Basée sur les Qualifications des Consultants (CQS) , conformément au Règlement de passation des marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le financement de projets d’investissement de la Banque mondiale, dans l’édition applicable au projet, et au Plan de passation des marchés approuvé dans STEP. En outre, veuillez-vous référer aux informations spécifiques sur les conflits d’intérêts liées à cette mission comme énoncés au paragraphe 3.17 du Règlement de Passation des Marchés. Les Consultants peuvent s'associer à d'autres firmes pour améliorer leurs qualifications, mais ils doivent indiquer clairement si l'association prend la forme d’un groupement et/ou d’une sous-traitance. Dans le cas d’un groupement, tous les membres du groupement d’entreprises seront solidairement responsables de l’ensemble du contrat, s’ils sont sélectionnés.   Des informations supplémentaires peuvent être obtenues à l’adresse et aux heures suivantes : UGP- PRSA (FSRP II) , Sise au quartier Klemat, Av. record.notice_text:
REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

Individual Consultant Selection

Ethiopian Statistical Service (ESS)

Reference No.: ET-ESS-574154-CS-INDV

Hiring of Financial Management Specialist

The Ethiopian Statistical Service (ESS) intends to recruit a Financial Management Specialist under the Modernizing Ethiopia's Statistical System Project (MESSP) Preparation Grant, financed by the World Bank.

The Financial Management Specialist will support the Project Implementation Unit (PIU) in ensuring sound financial planning, budgeting, accounting, internal control, disbursement, financial reporting, audit coordination, and compliance with Government of Ethiopia and World Bank financial management requirements.

The position will play a critical role in maintaining transparent and accountable use of project resources, ensuring timely preparation of financial reports and withdrawal applications, effective budget monitoring, and strong controls over project expenditures and advances.

Duty Station: ESS Headquarters, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.

Reporting: The Financial Management Specialist will report to the Project Manager.

Contract Duration: Full-time assignment. The contract shall commence upon recruitment and cover the project preparation phase and subsequent project implementation period. The initial contract period shall be one (1) year, renewable annually based on satisfactory performance and project requirements.

Minimum Qualification Requirements

Interested candidates should possess:

  • Master's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Professional certification such as ACCA, CPA, or equivalent is an added advantage.
  • Minimum of ten (10) years of relevant professional experience for candidates holding a Master's degree or ACCA/CPA certification.
  • At least four (4) years of experience in financial management of donor-funded projects, preferably World Bank-financed projects.
  • Knowledge of IPSAS and public financial management systems is an advantage.
  • Experience with accounting software such as Peachtree Accounting and IFMIS.
  • Strong analytical, budgeting, financial reporting, and internal control skills.
  • Excellent computer skills, particularly in MS Excel and accounting applications, together with strong communication and interpersonal skills.

The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) can be obtained from the Ethiopian Statistical Service (ESS) upon request.

The consultant will be selected using the Selection of Individual Consultants (INDV) method in accordance with the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers.

Submission Requirements

Interested candidates shall submit Physically:

  • An Expression of Interest (EOI);
  • Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV); and
  • Supporting documents demonstrating relevant qualifications and experience.

Deadline for Submission: 03 Nov 2026 G.C at 5:30 PM (Ethiopia Time)

Subject Line: Expression of Interest – Financial Management Specialist – ET-ESS-574154-CS-INDV

Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
Email: ayalewdejene69@gmail.com

O processo será conduzido através de concurso nacional usando uma Solicitação de Proposta (SPD) e está aberto a todos os Concorrentes elegíveis. notice_text: Specific Procurement Notice (SPN) Request for Proposals without Prequalification Information Systems (Design, Supply and Installation) Purchaser: Forward Digital Mena Project: Digital Skilling for Employment (DSE) Project – P506407 Contract Title: Design, Development and Deployment of an AI-Enabled Digital Skills and Employment Platform (nammiskills V2) Country: Lebanon Grant No.: TF-D1121 RFP No.: LB-FORWARDMENA-575936-GO-RFP Issued on: 19 October 2026 1. Forward Digital Mena has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Digital Skilling for Employment (DSE) Project (P506407), and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for Design, Development and Deployment of an AI-Enabled Digital Skills and Employment Platform (nammiskills V2). For this contract, the Borrower shall process the payments using the Direct Payment disbursement method, as defined in the World Bank's Disbursement Guidelines for Investment Project Financing, except for those payments which the contract provides to be made through letter of credit. 2. Forward Digital Mena now invites sealed Proposals from eligible Proposers for Design, Development, Deployment, Integration, Testing, Commissioning, and Support of an AI-enabled Digital Skills and Employment Platform (nammiskills V2) in Lebanon. The assignment includes the enhancement and further development of the existing nammiskills platform, including its Learner, Employer and Administrator spaces, AI-enabled functionalities, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) setup and configuration and the provision of the required CRM subscriptions, third-party integrations, data and system migration, cloud deployment, security and data protection requirements, training, documentation, warranty and post-deployment support. The Information System (IS) is expected to be implemented over a period of 27 weeks . The contract shall also cover the provision of CRM subscriptions, maintenance, technical support and related follow-up services, as specified in the RFP, through 31 December 2027 , which constitutes the contractual completion date. 3. The procurement process will be conducted through international competitive procurement using Request for Proposals (RFP) as specified in the World Bank's Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers , September 2025 ("Procurement Regulations"), and is open to all eligible Proposers as defined in the Procurement Regulations. 4. Proposals will be evaluated in accordance with the evaluation process set out in the RFP document. The following weightings shall apply: Rated Criteria (including technical and non-price factors): 70% ; Proposal cost: 30% . 5. Interested eligible Proposers may obtain further information from Forward Digital Mena, Attention: Michelle Boustany, Procurement Specialist, at procurement@forwardmena.org. The Request for Proposals document will be available electronically as specified below. 6. The Request for Proposals document in English will be provided free of charge to interested eligible Proposers upon submission of a written request by email to procurement@forwardmena.org. The Request for Proposals document will be sent electronically by email. 7. Proposals must be submitted physically to the address indicated below or electronically by email to procurement@forwardmena.org on or before 30 November 2026 at 12:00 noon (Beirut local time) . Electronic submission will be permitted. Late Proposals will be rejected. For electronic submission, Proposals shall be submitted in two separate parts: (i) the Technical Part and (ii) the Financial Part. Both parts shall be submitted as separate encrypted, password-protected electronic files. Passwords shall not be included in the submission email. The password for the Technical Part shall be provided during the scheduled Technical Proposal opening, following the Purchaser's instructions. The password for the Financial Part shall not be provided at the time of Proposal submission or during the Technical Proposal opening. The Technical Parts will be opened on 30 November 2026 at 12:30 PM (Beirut local time) , in the presence of Proposers' designated representatives who choose to attend, either physically or virtually. Virtual connection details will be communicated to Proposers in advance. The Financial Parts shall remain unopened and inaccessible to the Purchaser during the technical evaluation. Following completion of the technical evaluation, only Proposers whose Technical Parts qualify for progression to the financial evaluation will be invited to provide the passwords for their Financial Parts for the subsequent Financial Proposal opening. The location, date and time of the Financial Proposal opening will be communicated to those Proposers in accordance with the RFP. 8. All Proposals must be accompanied by a Proposal Security of USD 15,000 (Fifteen Thousand United States Dollars), in hard copy , in accordance with the requirements specified in the RFP document. 9. Attention is drawn to the Procurement Regulations requiring the Borrower to disclose information on the successful Proposer's beneficial ownership as part of the Contract Award Notice, using the Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Form included in the RFP document. 10. The address referred to above is: Forward Digital Mena Attention: Procurement Specialist BDD 1294 Building, Bachoura Street, 2nd Floor Beirut, Lebanon Telephone: +961 76 792140 Email: procurement@forwardmena.org Website: www.forwardmena.org

notice_text: MINISTERE DE L’AGRICULTURE ET DE LA SOUVERAINETE ALIMENTAIRE ------------- SECRETARIAT GENERAL -------------- DIRECTION GENERALE DE L’AGRICULTURE ---------------- PROJET DE PRODUCTIVITE ET DE RESILIENCE DES MOYENS DE SUBSISTANCE RURAUX (RIZ PLUS) --------------- Crédit IDA 72800 - COFN-C2530 ----------- AVIS DE DEMANDE DE PRIX FOURNITURE DE MATERIELS ET EQUIPEMENTS APICOLES POUR LA CODIFICATION DES RUCHERS REPARTIS EN DEUX (02) LOTS : •           Lot 1 - Matériels pour la codification des ruchers •           Lot 2 - EPI et matériels apicoles   Référence : FRN-029/MG-RIZPLUS/2026 Date de lancement : 19 octobre 2026 1. Le Gouvernement de la République de Madagascar a reçu un financement de la Banque Mondiale pour financer le Projet de productivité et de résilience des moyens de subsistance ruraux (RIZ PLUS), et à l’intention d’utiliser une partie de ce crédit pour effectuer des paiements au titre du Marché objet du présent avis . Le contrat sera financé conjointement par l’Agence Française de Développement (AFD). La passation du Marché sera conforme aux règles de passation des marchés de la Banque mondiale. 2. L’Unité de Gestion du Projet RIZPLUS sollicite des offres fermées de la part de soumissionnaires éligibles et répondant aux qualifications requises pour la fourniture de matériels et équipements apicoles pour la codification des ruchers . Delivery shall be made to the Public Enterprise for Water Management Activities “Hydrosystem Zletovica” - Probishtip, at a location designated by the Purchaser. The procurement is a single indivisible package; partial quotations will not be considered. 3.  Procurement will be conducted using the Request for Quotations (RFQ) method with an open national market approach, in accordance with the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, Seventh Edition, September 2025. Participation is open to all eligible and qualified bidders from any country, in accordance with these Regulations and the conditions set out in the RFQ. 4.  The complete RFQ documentation, including all annexes, may be obtained free of charge in electronic form by submitting a written request to procurement@amp.mk, quoting reference number PIREP-GO-RFQ-12. Quotations shall be delivered in person, by post or by courier, in a sealed envelope marked: “PIREP-GO-RFQ-12 - IT EQUIPMENT - DO NOT OPEN BEFORE THE SUBMISSION DEADLINE” Late quotations will not be considered. Submission of quotations by email is not permitted. Address for quotation submission and contact details Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Water Economy Project Implementation Unit Attention: Ms. Ana Gaceva 2 Leninova Street, 1000 Skopje Republic of North Macedonia Email for documentation and clarification: procurement@amp.mk

notice_text: PRIMATURE           ---------     PROJET DE FILETS SOCIAUX ET RESILIENCE Crédit IDA 72630 APPEL A MANIFESTATION D’INTERET N°46/AMI/FID/DIRGEN/RECRUTEMENT CI FORM MNGT_LEADERSHIP/FSR/26   RECRUTEMENT D’UN CONSULTANT FORMATEUR EN MANAGEMENT ET LEADERSHIP. La République de Madagascar a reçu des financements de l’Association Internationale pour le Développement pour financer le Projet de Filets Sociaux de Sécurité et le Projet de Filets de Sécurité et de Résilience. Le Fonds d’Intervention pour le Développement (FID) a l’intention d’utiliser une partie du montant de ces dons pour effectuer les paiements au titre des prestations décrites en (2) ci-après ; Le Consultant formateur sera chargé de renforcer les capacités en leadership des RSI et RSE au niveau des Directions et des Antennes interrégionales, ainsi que celles des responsables au sein de la DPSESI de la Direction Générale. Le FID invite les candidats admissibles à manifester leur intérêt et fournir les informations démontrant qu’ils possèdent les qualifications requises et des expériences pertinentes pour l’exécution des prestations : QUALIFICATIONS MINIMALES REQUISES : Diplôme : Titulaire d’un diplôme minimum Bac +5 en management, leadership, gestion des ressources humaines, sciences de gestion, psychologie du travail, sociologie des organisations ou dans tout autre domaine apparenté Expérience(s) : Avoir plus de 10 ans d'expériences générales dans l'accompagnement des cadres, managers et dirigeants 10 ans d’expériences dans le domaine du management, encadrement d’équipes, leadership organisationnel ou conduite du changement. Avoir réalisé avec succès au moins 7 contrats de prestations en tant que formateur, coach ou facilitateur en management et leadership, au cours des 10 dernières années, dans des contextes institutionnels, de projets ou d’organisations structurées, dûment justifiés par des références ou attestations. Avoir mené avec succès au moins 7 contrats de prestations portant sur la transformation managériale, la conduite du changement, le développement des compétences en leadership, l’intelligence émotionnelle et/ou la performance collective, au cours des 10 dernières années, avec preuves de résultats ou références professionnelles. Justifier d’une excellente maîtrise écrite et orale de la langue malagasy et française, permettant d’assurer des formations de qualité, incluant la rédaction de supports pédagogiques clairs et structurés, ainsi qu’une diction fluide, claire et professionnelle adaptée à des publics variés.,   Atouts : Ayant des expertises sur le : Leadership situationnel, posture managériale, gestion des conflits, animation de réunions, délégation efficace. Développement du charisme, vision, intelligence émotionnelle, influence et assertivité. Écoute active, feedback constructif, communication non violente, prise de parole en public. Accompagnement des transformations organisationnelles, engagement des équipes, gestion des résistances. Coaching de managers, accompagnement des leaders dans la prise de poste et le développement de leur leadership. Expérience de travail dans des projets financés par des bailleurs de fonds ou dans des environnements multiculturels ;   Seules les expériences citées par le candidat dans son CV, qui sont justifiées par les documents de sa participation aux domaines de compétences suscitées, seront considérées comme expériences acceptées.   Il est porté à l’attention des candidats que les dispositions des paragraphes 3.13 et suivants du «  Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement de Projets d’Investissement (FPI)– 7è édition Septembre 2025 publié par la Banque mondiale » en matière de conflits d’intérêts sont applicables.   Les Consultants seront sélectionnés selon la méthode « Sélection de Consultant Individuel (SCI) » telle que décrite dans ledit Règlement.   Les Candidats intéressés peuvent obtenir les termes de référence détaillés ici : https://t.ly/F4O3P et des Informations supplémentaires à l’adresse (08) ci-dessous.   Tout candidat intéressé est invité à soumettre sa candidature, au plus tard le 01 SEPTEMBRE 2026 , avec la « Référence du présent AMI » dans le lien ci-après :  https://recrutement.fid-server.org/consultant-externe/ L’adresse susmentionnée fait référence à : FID - DIRECTION GENERALE Lot III M 39 Andrefan’Ambohijanahary Antananarivo 101 3ème étage, Bâtiment B Ou par voie électronique à l’adresse procurement@fid.mg et comme objet la référence du présent AMI. Nota Bene  : Seuls les dossiers de candidature soumis dans le lien ci-dessus (7) seront traités    Veuillez préparer au préalable les documents suivants, en version image ou PDF, avant la soumission de votre candidature en ligne : Lettre de motivation signée ; Curriculum Vitae signé avec photo  ; Copie Diplômes ; Toutes les pièces justificatives : attestations de travail, attestation de stage ou attestation de bonne fin de prestation c. Le présent appel peut être annulé dans une des conditions suivantes : La concurrence aurait été insuffisante ; Aucune candidature conforme aux présents TdR n’aurait été reçue ; Le financement de la présente mission relative aux présents TdR est interrompu ou annulé Seules les candidatures soumises dans le site web du FID seront recevables.     Antananarivo, le 18 Août 2026   La Direction Générale du FID

PRIMATURE

PROJET DE FILETS SOCIAUX ET RESILIENCE

Crédit IDA 72630

APPEL A MANIFESTATION D’INTERET N°46/AMI/FID/DIRGEN/RECRUTEMENT CI FORM MNGT_LEADERSHIP/FSR/26

 

RECRUTEMENT D’UN CONSULTANT FORMATEUR EN MANAGEMENT ET LEADERSHIP.

  1. La République de Madagascar a reçu des financements de l’Association Internationale pour le Développement pour financer le Projet de Filets Sociaux de Sécurité et le Projet de Filets de Sécurité et de Résilience. Le Fonds d’Intervention pour le Développement (FID) a l’intention d’utiliser une partie du montant de ces dons pour effectuer les paiements au titre des prestations décrites en (2) ci-après ;
  2. Le Consultant formateur sera chargé de renforcer les capacités en leadership des RSI et RSE au niveau des Directions et des Antennes interrégionales, ainsi que celles des responsables au sein de la DPSESI de la Direction Générale.
  3. Le FID invite les candidats admissibles à manifester leur intérêt et fournir les informations démontrant qu’ils possèdent les qualifications requises et des expériences pertinentes pour l’exécution des prestations :

QUALIFICATIONS MINIMALES REQUISES :

Diplôme :

Titulaire d’un diplôme minimum Bac +5 en management, leadership, gestion des ressources humaines, sciences de gestion, psychologie du travail, sociologie des organisations ou dans tout autre domaine apparenté

Expérience(s) :

  • Avoir plus de 10 ans d'expériences générales dans l'accompagnement des cadres, managers et dirigeants
  • 10 ans d’expériences dans le domaine du management, encadrement d’équipes, leadership organisationnel ou conduite du changement.
  • Avoir réalisé avec succès au moins 7 contrats de prestations en tant que formateur, coach ou facilitateur en management et leadership, au cours des 10 dernières années, dans des contextes institutionnels, de projets ou d’organisations structurées, dûment justifiés par des références ou attestations.
  • Avoir mené avec succès au moins 7 contrats de prestations portant sur la transformation managériale, la conduite du changement, le développement des compétences en leadership, l’intelligence émotionnelle et/ou la performance collective, au cours des 10 dernières années, avec preuves de résultats ou références professionnelles.
  • Justifier d’une excellente maîtrise écrite et orale de la langue malagasy et française, permettant d’assurer des formations de qualité, incluant la rédaction de supports pédagogiques clairs et structurés, ainsi qu’une diction fluide, claire et professionnelle adaptée à des publics variés.,

 

Atouts :

Ayant des expertises sur le :

  • Leadership situationnel, posture managériale, gestion des conflits, animation de réunions, délégation efficace.
  • Développement du charisme, vision, intelligence émotionnelle, influence et assertivité.

notice_text: REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST   (CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRMS SELECTION)   REPUBLIC OF UZBEKISTAN CONNECTIVITY AND TRANSPORT SECTOR IMPROVEMENT PROJECT   Project ID: P509487 Assignment Title: Development of a Standard Framework for Public Service Obligation (PSO) Contracts for Passenger Rail Transport in Uzbekistan Reference No. (as per Procurement Plan): UZ-CTSIP-1004-CS-QCBS-UTY-PM-02 The Republic of Uzbekistan has applied for financing from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) of the World Bank Group toward the cost of the Connectivity and Transport Sector Improvement Project (CTSIP), and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services. The consulting services ("the Services") include the development of a practical and implementable Public Service Obligation (PSO) contract framework for passenger rail transport in Uzbekistan, comprising analytical assessment of PSO applicability; development of service quality standards (SLA/KPI); preparation of a standard PSO contract structure and templates; development of a subsidy calculation methodology and analytical calculator; establishment of monitoring and reporting arrangements; definition of institutional interaction mechanisms; preparation of regulatory proposals; and development of a phased implementation roadmap. The expected duration of the assignment is 9 (nine) months from contract signature. The Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment are attached to this request for expressions of interest. JSC “O‘zbekiston temir yo‘llari” (the “Client”) now invites eligible consulting firms ("Consultants") to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The shortlisting criteria are: Experience in Tariff and Regulatory Analysis in the Transport Sector: The Consultant shall demonstrate a proven track record of having successfully completed a minimum of two (2) assignments within the past three (3) years, each involving tariff analysis, regulatory reform, or financial sustainability assessment of transport services. At least one (1) such assignment should be in a CIS country. Prior experience on assignments financed by International Financial Institutions (IFIs) is essential. In substantiation of the above, the Firm shall provide verifiable client references for all qualifying assignments. Economic and Financial Analysis of Socially Significant Transport Services: The Consultant should demonstrate relevant experience in the economic and financial analysis of public transport services, including but not limited to the assessment of cost structures, revenue shortfalls, and the budgetary implications of PSO programs. The Firm shall provide evidence of having successfully completed comparable assignments, with prior experience on IFI-financed engagements considered essential. All qualifying experience shall be substantiated through verifiable client references submitted as part of the Firm's technical proposal. Legal Expertise in Public Service Contractual Documentation: The Consultant shall demonstrate experience in at least one (1) completed assignment involving the legal drafting of Public Service Obligations (PSO) documents, concession agreements, or equivalent contractual instruments within a CIS or EU country. Demonstrable knowledge of Uzbekistan's civil law framework and public budget legislation is required for the satisfactory performance of this assignment. Regulatory Reform and Institutional Engagement in Uzbekistan: The Consultant shall demonstrate experience in at least one (1) completed assignment undertaken directly in the Republic of Uzbekistan, encompassing regulatory drafting, policy development, or interagency coordination with national ministries or regulatory authorities. Such experience shall attest to the Firm's capacity to navigate the institutional and legislative environment of Uzbekistan effectively. Experience in the transport sector will be considered an advantage. Local Expertise and In-Country Presence: The Consultant shall demonstrate an established operational and legal presence in Tashkent, Republic of Uzbekistan. The proposed team shall include qualified in-country experts with full professional proficiency in Uzbek and/or Russian, and with demonstrable familiarity with Uzbekistan's governance structures, institutional arrangements, and public budget frameworks. Such local presence and expertise are considered essential to ensure effective stakeholder engagement and timely delivery of assignment outputs. (Note: Consultants shall clearly describe relevant assignments, indicating the client, country, duration, scope of services, financing source, and role of the firm, supported by verifiable client references.) Key Experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage. The shortlist will contain 5 to 8 firms. The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs 3.13, 3.15, and 3.16 of the World Bank's “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” September 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank's policy on conflict of interest. Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications, but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected. A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost-Based Selection (QCBS) method, as set out in the World Bank's Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers and as further detailed in the Request for Proposals (RFP). Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours. Expressions of interest must be delivered in a written form to the address below (in person, or by mail, or by e-mail) by November 2, 2026 8 p.m. (Tashkent time). Late expressions of interest will be rejected. Interested firms may obtain the Terms of Reference upon written request submitted to the Project Implementation Unit at the following address: u.dosmetov@uzrailway.uz JSC “O‘zbekiston temir yo‘llari” Attn: Dosmetov Ulugbek Sultanbay ugli, Head of the Transformation Office 7, Taras Shevchenko Street, Mirabad district 100060, Tashkent city, Republic of Uzbekistan Tel: +998 90 318 36 66 E-mail: u.dosmetov@uzrailway.uz

record.bid_description: Development of a practical and implementable Public Service Obligation contract framework for passenger rail transport, including contractual structures, subsidy calculation methodologies, analytical tools, and implementation arrangements.
record.contact_address: 7, Taras Shevchenko Street Mirabad District, 100060 Tashkent, Republic of Uzbekistan
record.notice_text:
REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

 

(CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRMS SELECTION)

 

REPUBLIC OF UZBEKISTAN

CONNECTIVITY AND TRANSPORT SECTOR IMPROVEMENT PROJECT

 

Project ID: P509487

Assignment Title: Development of a Standard Framework for Public Service Obligation (PSO) Contracts for Passenger Rail Transport in Uzbekistan

Reference No. (as per Procurement Plan): UZ-CTSIP-1004-CS-QCBS-UTY-PM-02

The Republic of Uzbekistan has applied for financing from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) of the World Bank Group toward the cost of the Connectivity and Transport Sector Improvement Project (CTSIP), and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services ("the Services") include the development of a practical and implementable Public Service Obligation (PSO) contract framework for passenger rail transport in Uzbekistan, comprising analytical assessment of PSO applicability; development of service quality standards (SLA/KPI); preparation of a standard PSO contract structure and templates; development of a subsidy calculation methodology and analytical calculator; establishment of monitoring and reporting arrangements; definition of institutional interaction mechanisms; preparation of regulatory proposals; and development of a phased implementation roadmap. The expected duration of the assignment is 9 (nine) months from contract signature.

The Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment are attached to this request for expressions of interest.

JSC “O‘zbekiston temir yo‘llari” (the “Client”) now invites eligible consulting firms ("Consultants") to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

The shortlisting criteria are:

  1. Experience in Tariff and Regulatory Analysis in the Transport Sector: The Consultant shall demonstrate a proven track record of having successfully completed a minimum of two (2) assignments within the past three (3) years, each involving tariff analysis, regulatory reform, or financial sustainability assessment of transport services. At least one (1) such assignment should be in a CIS country. Prior experience on assignments financed by International Financial Institutions (IFIs) is essential. In substantiation of the above, the Firm shall provide verifiable client references for all qualifying assignments.
  2. Economic and Financial Analysis of Socially Significant Transport Services: The Consultant should demonstrate relevant experience in the economic and financial analysis of public transport services, including but not limited to the assessment of cost structures, revenue shortfalls, and the budgetary implications of PSO programs. The Firm shall provide evidence of having successfully completed comparable assignments, with prior experience on IFI-financed engagements considered essential. All qualifying experience shall be substantiated through verifiable client references submitted as part of the Firm's technical proposal.
  3. Legal Expertise in Public Service Contractual Documentation: The Consultant shall demonstrate experience in at least one (1) completed assignment involving the legal drafting of Public Service Obligations (PSO) documents, concession agreements, or equivalent contractual instruments within a CIS or EU country. Demonstrable knowledge of Uzbekistan's civil law framework and public budget legislation is required for the satisfactory performance of this assignment.
  4. Regulatory Reform and Institutional Engagement in Uzbekistan: The Consultant shall demonstrate experience in at least one (1) completed assignment undertaken directly in the Republic of Uzbekistan, encompassing regulatory drafting, policy development, or interagency coordination with national ministries or regulatory authorities. Such experience shall attest to the Firm's capacity to navigate the institutional and legislative environment of Uzbekistan effectively. Experience in the transport sector will be considered an advantage.
  5. Local Expertise and In-Country Presence: The Consultant shall demonstrate an established operational and legal presence in Tashkent, Republic of Uzbekistan. The proposed team shall include qualified in-country experts with full professional proficiency in Uzbek and/or Russian, and with demonstrable familiarity with Uzbekistan's governance structures, institutional arrangements, and public budget frameworks. Such local presence and expertise are considered essential to ensure effective stakeholder engagement and timely delivery of assignment outputs.

(Note: Consultants shall clearly describe relevant assignments, indicating the client, country, duration, scope of services, financing source, and role of the firm, supported by verifiable client references.)

Key Experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage.

The shortlist will contain 5 to 8 firms.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs 3.13, 3.15, and 3.16 of the World Bank's “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” September 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank's policy on conflict of interest.

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications, but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost-Based Selection (QCBS) method, as set out in the World Bank's Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers and as further detailed in the Request for Proposals (RFP).

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours.

Expressions of interest must be delivered in a written form to the address below (in person, or by mail, or by e-mail) by November 2, 2026 8 p.m. (Tashkent time). Late expressions of interest will be rejected.

Interested firms may obtain the Terms of Reference upon written request submitted to the Project Implementation Unit at the following address: u.dosmetov@uzrailway.uz

notice_text: Título do Contrato : Aquisição de Equipamento Informático para o apoio à expansão e desenvolvimento do Sistema Nacional da Contratação Pública Electrónica   Referência do RFB No.: AO/MINFIN/573466/GO/RFB   Governo de Angola (GoA) celebrou um acordo de financiamento com o Banco Mundial para a implementação do Projecto de Reforço da Governação para a Melhoria da Prestação de Serviços, cujos objectivos são: (i) aumentar o montante e a fiabilidade das transferências fiscais para municípios seleccionados; (ii) reforçar a capacidade de gestão financeira e fundiária; (iii) aumentar a cobertura de identificação. O projecto é multissectorial, envolvendo os seguintes Departamentos Ministeriais: Ministério das Finanças, Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos, Ministério das Obras Públicas, Urbanismo e Habitação, Ministério da Administração Pública, Trabalho e Segurança Social e o Ministério da Administração do Território, que é responsável pela coordenação através de uma Unidade de Implementação do Projecto (UIP), e pretende aplicar parte dos fundos para pagamentos no âmbito do Aquisição de Equipamento Informático para o apoio à expansão e desenvolvimento do Sistema Nacional da Contratação Pública Electrónica . Para este contrato, o Mutuário utilizará o método de desembolso de Pagamento Directo, conforme definido nas Directrizes de Desembolso do Banco Mundial para Financiamento de Projectos de Investimento.   O Projecto de Reforço da Governação para a Melhoria da Prestação de Serviços convida concorrentes elegíveis a apresentar propostas seladas para: Aquisição de Equipamento Informático para o apoio à expansão e desenvolvimento do Sistema Nacional da Contratação Pública Electrónica   O escopo inclui fornecimento, entrega, instalação, configuração, testes, entrada em funcionamento, garantia e assistência pós-venda. Destino Final: Luanda. Prazo de entrega e instalação: Conforme especificado no Documento de Concurso. O processo será conduzido por meio de Concurso Público Internacional, utilizando o método de Solicitação de Propostas (RFB), e está aberto a todos os concorrentes elegíveis, conforme definido nos Regulamentos de Aquisições.   A aquisição seguirá um procedimento de fase única, com dois envelopes.   Avaliação Técnica   A componente técnica das propostas será avaliada considerando os critérios e pesos percentuais indicados na tabela abaixo:   Nº Critério  (%) 1 Solução Técnica e Conformidade 40% 2 Metodologia de Implementação e Plano de Trabalho 24% 3     Experiência Relevante 14% 4     Pessoal-Chave e Especialização Técnica   14% 5 Suporte Pós-Venda e Capacidade de Assistência 8%   Total 100%   Os concorrentes elegíveis interessados poderão obter informações adicionais e consultar o Documento de Concurso durante o horário normal de expediente no endereço abaixo. O Documento de Concurso, em língua inglesa , poderá ser obtido pelos concorrentes elegíveis interessados mediante solicitação escrita ao endereço abaixo. As propostas deverão ser entregues no endereço abaixo, até:       Data: 1 de Dezembro de 2026, ás 14h (hora local)       Não será permitida a submissão electrónica.        Propostas apresentadas fora do prazo serão rejeitadas. Abertura das Propostas As propostas técnicas serão abertas em sessão pública, na presença dos representantes designados pelos concorrentes e de quaisquer interessados que desejem participar, no endereço abaixo, na seguinte data: 01 de Dezembro de 2026, às 14h(hora local). As propostas financeiras dos concorrentes tecnicamente conformes serão abertas numa data posterior, a ser comunicada de acordo com o Documento de Concurso. Garantia da Proposta Todas as propostas deverão ser acompanhadas de uma Garantia de Proposta, no montante e na forma especificados no Documento de Concurso.  Endereço para Esclarecimentos e Submissão Endereço: Ministério da Administração do Território (MAT), 5.º Andar, Complexo Administrativo Talatona Classic, Município de Talatona Att.:  Santinho Filipe Figueira Tel.:  +244 923 494871 E-mail:   procurement.ucpdegovernacao@gmail.com

Título do Contrato: Aquisição de Equipamento Informático para o apoio à expansão e desenvolvimento do Sistema Nacional da Contratação Pública Electrónica

 

Referência do RFB No.: AO/MINFIN/573466/GO/RFB

 

Governo de Angola (GoA) celebrou um acordo de financiamento com o Banco Mundial para a implementação do Projecto de Reforço da Governação para a Melhoria da Prestação de Serviços, cujos objectivos são: (i) aumentar o montante e a fiabilidade das transferências fiscais para municípios seleccionados; (ii) reforçar a capacidade de gestão financeira e fundiária; (iii) aumentar a cobertura de identificação. O projecto é multissectorial, envolvendo os seguintes Departamentos Ministeriais: Ministério das Finanças, Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos, Ministério das Obras Públicas, Urbanismo e Habitação, Ministério da Administração Pública, Trabalho e Segurança Social e o Ministério da Administração do Território, que é responsável pela coordenação através de uma Unidade de Implementação do Projecto (UIP), e pretende aplicar parte dos fundos para pagamentos no âmbito do Aquisição de Equipamento Informático para o apoio à expansão e desenvolvimento do Sistema Nacional da Contratação Pública Electrónica. Para este contrato, o Mutuário utilizará o método de desembolso de Pagamento Directo, conforme definido nas Directrizes de Desembolso do Banco Mundial para Financiamento de Projectos de Investimento.

 

  1. O Projecto de Reforço da Governação para a Melhoria da Prestação de Serviços convida concorrentes elegíveis a apresentar propostas seladas para: Aquisição de Equipamento Informático para o apoio à expansão e desenvolvimento do Sistema Nacional da Contratação Pública Electrónica

  O escopo inclui fornecimento, entrega, instalação, configuração, testes, entrada em funcionamento, garantia e assistência pós-venda.

Destino Final: Luanda.

Prazo de entrega e instalação: Conforme especificado no Documento de Concurso.

  1. O processo será conduzido por meio de Concurso Público Internacional, utilizando o método de Solicitação de Propostas (RFB), e está aberto a todos os concorrentes elegíveis, conforme definido nos Regulamentos de Aquisições.

 

A aquisição seguirá um procedimento de fase única, com dois envelopes.

O Documento de Concurso, em língua inglesa, poderá ser obtido pelos concorrentes elegíveis interessados mediante solicitação escrita ao endereço abaixo.

01 de Dezembro de 2026, às 14h(hora local).

notice_text: Avis d’Appel d’offres Corps de services SALAIRE : Mauritanie NOM DU PROJET : Projet d’appui à la décentralisation et au développement des Villes intermédiaires productives-MOUDOUN Marché :  Réalisation d’une Opération de recensement à vocation foncière à Rosso Don :       IDA N° IDA 5750-MR  Sans référence : DAO n° 08 / CPMP/MOUDOUN/2026 Emis le : 19/10/2026 Cet Avis d’appel d’offres fait suite à l’Avis Général de Passation des Marchés publié le 23 octobre 2020 et le PPM 2026 Le Gou vernement de la République Islamique de Mauritanie a reçu un financement de Banque Mondiale pour financer le Projet d’appui à la décentralisation et aux Villes intermédiaires productives-MOUDOUN, et a l’intention d’utiliser une partie de ce don pour effectuer des paiements au titre des services de Réalisation d’une Opération de recensement à vocation foncière à Rosso. Pour ce marché, l’Emprunteur procédera aux paiements en utilisant la méthode de décaissement telle que définie dans les Directives de Décaissement de la Banque Mondiale pour le financement des projets d’investissements. Le Projet MOUDOUN sollicite des offres fermées de la part de soumissionnaires éligibles et répondant aux qualifications requises pour fournir services de  Réalisation d’une Opération de recensement à vocation foncière à Rosso  La procédure sera conduite par mise en concurrence en recourant à un Appel d’Offres National (AON) telle que définie dans le «  Règlement applicable aux Emprunteurs – Passation des Marchés dans le cadre de Financement de Projets ( édition de juillet 2016, révisée en novembre 2017, août 2018, novembre 2020 et septembre 2023 « le Règlement de passation des marchés »,  » et ouverte à tous les soumissionnaires de pays éligibles tels que définis dans le Règlement de passation des marchés. Les Soumissionnaires intéressés et éligibles peuvent obtenir des informations auprès de du projet MOUDOUN -contact : Mahi Ould Hamed : mahi@moudoun.mr, cpmp@moudoun.mr et prendre connaissance des documents d’Appel d’offres à l’adresse mentionnée ci-après : MOUDOUN (Projet d’appui à la Décentralisation et au Développement des Villes Intermédiaires Productives). IIot Nasser lot n°173 Ksar Ouest BP 5150 Nouakchott, MAURITANIE de 9 heures à 16 heures Les exigences en matière de qualification sont : Avoir un chiffre d’affaires annuel d’au moins : Quinze millions d’ouguiya (15 000 000 MRU) Ce Chiffre d’affaires sera calculé de la manière suivante : le total des paiements mandatés reçus pour les marchés en cours et/ou achevés au cours des trois (3) dernières années (2023, 2024 et 2025) divisées par trois (3). Les montants de travaux doivent être justifiés exclusivement par des attestations établies par les maitres d’ouvrage et maitres d’œuvres. Pour se voir accepter ces attestations devront (i) mentionner le montant du marché et sa date de réalisation, ou à défaut joindre à l’attestation la page de garde du contrat. Et doivent être délivrées par des personnes morales publiques, parapubliques ou par tout autre organisme international reconnu. Disposer d’avoir liquide ou de facilités de crédit :  Le Soumissionnaire doit démontrer qu’il dispose d’avoir liquides ou accès à des actifs non grevés ou des lignes de crédit, etc. autres que l’avance de démarrage éventuelle, à des montants suffisants pour subvenir aux besoins de trésorerie nécessaires à l’exécution des travaux objet du présent Appel d’Offres à hauteur de Trois millions d’ouguiya  (3 000 000 MRU) Avoir réalisé, durant les cinq (05) dernières années (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022 et 2021), en tant qu’entreprise principale des projets de travaux comme suit : Au moins Un (01) marché de nature et de complexité similaire. Cette expérience devra être prouvée par des attestations confirmées par des maitres d’ouvrages et les travaux devraient être achevés au moins à 80 %. Disposer du personnel d’encadrement clé décrit à la Section III (Critères d’évaluation et de qualification) paragraphe 4. Personnel clé. Disposer du matériel minimum décrit à la Section III (Critères d’évaluation et de qualification) pour l’exécution des travaux. 2.         The Ministry of Education and Science of Ukraine invites eligible participants to submit proposals for the provision of services Security authorization services for the server-side integrated information system of the EDEBO. The expected duration of the provision of services is 7 (seven) months from the date of signing the contract.

3.         IBRD requires compliance with the Bank's Anti-Corruption Guidelines and its applicable sanctions policies and procedures, as outlined in the World Bank Group Sanctions Framework. In further compliance with this policy, Bidders shall permit and require their agents (whether declared or not), subcontractors, sub-consultants, service providers, suppliers and personnel to permit the Bank to inspect all invoices, records and other documents relating to the request for quotations and execution of the contract (in case of award), as well as for their verification by auditors appointed by the Bank.

notice_text: Specific Procurement Notice Template Request for Bids Small Works (One-Envelope Bidding Process) Country: Lebanon Name of Project: Lebanon Emergency Assistance Project (LEAP) Contract Title: Rehabilitation of Shelters (Public Schools) -Batch 5: Lot 1 Lot 2 and Lot 3. Loan No.: 9841 - LB RFB Reference No.: LEAP-SH-SW-MEHE- Batch 5   1. The Republic of Lebanon (hereinafter called "Borrower") has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Lebanon Emergency Assistance Project (LEAP) , and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for "Rehabilitation of Shelters (Public Schools) for Batch 5: Lot 1 Lot 2 and Lot 3". For these three contracts, the Borrower shall process the payments using the Direct Payment disburserrent method, as defined in the World Bank's Disburserrent Guidelines for hvestment Project Financing The project encorrpasses 3 distinct Lots categorized across different regions. The distribution for Bitch 5 includes: Batch 5 - 3 Bids: Request for Bid (RFB) Designation   Lot   Caza's Number of Schools   LEAP-SH-SW-MEHE- Batch 5 (lot 1)   Lot 1 Jezzine 3 Chouf 18   LEAP-SH-SW-MEHE- Batch 5 (lot 2)   Lot 2 West Bekaa 9 Zahle 7 Rashaya 8   LEAP-SH-SW-MEHE- Batch 5 (lot 3)   Lot3 Saida 16 Hasbaya 1   2. The Council for Development and Reconstruction (CDR) now invites sealed Bids from eligible Bidders for the "Rehabilitation of Shelters (Public Schools) - Batch 5: Lot 1, Lot 2- and Lot 3", consisting of providing restoration works to address the needs of buildings including the supply of material and implementation of repairs of items such as lighting, bathroom plumbing, painting, tiling, etc... of selected public buildings used as shelters, in compliance with applicable National and International Regulations and World Bank requirements for such. The scope is limited to light repair and improvement of accessibility works aimed at restoring basic safety, functionality, habitability, and dignity of use. These interventions are intended as quick-impact measures to improve school environment conditions. and restore the buildings to their primary function as educational facilities. The objective is to ensure they are safe and fully functional for    regular schooling. The interventions will be carried out in selected sites across the targeted locations. 3. Bidding will be conducted through National competitive procurement using a Request for Bids (RFB) as specified in the World Bank's "Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers - Sixth Edition, February 2025", and is open to all Bidders as defined in the Procurement Regulations. The contract will be awarded to the Bidder offering the lowest evaluated cost to the Employer, subject that the selected Bidder meets the required qualification criteria, and the requirements as specified under paragraph 4 below. 4. Bidders have the option to submit a Bid for one or more of the lots listed in the table above. Bidders submitting their bids for more than one lot, must ensure that the following criteria are met for the combined requirements of the lots included in their bid: Construction cash flow requirements stipulated in Section III - Evaluation and Qualification Criteria - Eligibility and Qualification Criteria Paragraph 3.1 Average Annual Construction Turnover requirements stipulated in Section III - Evaluation and Qualification Criteria - Eligibility and Qualification Criteria Paragraph 3.2 Key Personnel stipulated in Section III - Evaluation and Qualification Criteria Paragraph 4. Equipment stipulated in Section III - Evaluation and Qualification Criteria Paragraph 5. 5. Interested eligible Bidders may obtain further information from the Council for Development and Reconstruction and inspect the bidding documents at the address given below from 9:00 to 15:00 hours (Beirut local time) from Monday till Friday. 6. Interested eligible Bidders may purchase the bidding documents. The bidding document in English may be purchased by interested eligible Bidders upon the submission of a written application to the address below and upon payment of a nonrefundable fee of One Hundred fresh US Dollars (US$ 100) for each selected lot. The method of payment will be in cash (fresh USD). The document is to be picked up by a person duly authorized by the applicant. The cash is collected by the Tenders Department at CDR, and a receipt is issued to the person purchasing the bidding document at the time of payment. 7. Bids must be delivered to the address below at or before 12:00 noon Beirut Local Time on Friday , October 30,2026.  Electronic Bidding will not be permitted. Late Bids will be rejected. Bids will be publicly opened in the presence of the Bidders' designated representatives and anyone who chooses to attend at the address below at 12:00 noon Beirut Local Tme on Friday, October 30,2026. 8. All Bids must be accompanied by a Bid Security of Fifteen Thousand fresh US Dollars (US$ 15,000)  for each selected lot. 9. All Bids must be accompanied by a Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (SEA) and/or Sexual Harassment (SH) Declaration. 10. Attention is drawn to the Procurement Regulations requiring the Borrower to disclose information on the successful bidder's beneficial ownership, as part of the Contract Award Notice, using the Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Formas included in the biddingdocument. 11. A Pre-Bid Meeting (Physical Presence) will be held on Monday, October 26, 2026 at 10.A.M. Beirut Local Time. Place: Council for Development and Reconstruction (CDR) Tallet Al Serail, Beirut Central District (BCD) First Floor CDR Board Meeting Room 12. The address referred to above is: Council for Development and Reconstruction (CDR) Tenders Department Tallet El-Serail, Room No. 1166 Beirut - Lebanon               Telephone: +9611 981431/2 - Facsimile: +961 1 981255 Web site address: www.cdr.gov.lb

text:
